digest.component_or_area: LLM review operations retirement; CLI command aliasing
propositions: rebar review CLI verb must be retired in favour of rebar review-plan, which signs attestations and enforces a deterministic blocking floor, while the old verb must preserve read-only (unsigned) semantics via --no-sign forwarding
rebar review --graph and positional reviewer_id must reject with exit code 2 and message naming review-plan, preventing silent loss of arguments that have no counterpart on the target verb

rebar.llm.review_ticket library function and review_ticket MCP tool must be deprecated (not deleted) with three registry rows (cli, lib, mcp) using _scheduled removal, not _permanent, and internal harnesses (review_workflows, eval_solver) must call _review_ticket_impl directly to avoid double-signalling

review-plan fast-fails to INDETERMINATE (exit 2) with no LLM call on non-claimable tickets (closed/idea/blocked), diverging from the old verb which would run the model; this divergence is accepted and documented in help text
fourteen existing direct callers of rebar.llm.review_ticket must remain unedited and pass, proving the _review_ticket_impl split is behaviour-preserving and emitting no warnings from internal sites
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["review"] must repoint from REVIEW_RESULT to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT, with REVIEW_RESULT re-wired under synthetic "review_ticket" key to prevent schema orphaning
